text:
Senior Java Engineer
Nordquill
Remote
Salary: 4500–5500 EUR per month

About Nordquill
Nordquill builds payment reconciliation software for mid-sized European banks.

Your role
- Design and build services in Java and Spring Boot
- Own the Kafka event pipelines between core services
- Work with PostgreSQL on AWS

You have
- 5+ years of backend development in Java
- Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL
- Kubernetes and Terraform are a plus
- Upper-Intermediate English or higher

We offer
- Fully remote work
- 24 paid vacation days
- Equipment of your choice
